  <bpmn:process id="Process_You" name="Build a tree house" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:laneSet id="LaneSet_You">
      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_You" name="You">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Start_BuildingProcess</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_CollectRequirements</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_SendInitialRequirements</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Event_ReceiveDraft</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_RefinementDecision</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_RefineDraft</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_SendAdditionalRequirements</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_CreateMaterialsList</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_OrderMaterials</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_OrderAndFriendsSplit</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Event_OrderProcessed</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_AskFriendsToBuild</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_OrderAndFriendsJoin</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_BuildHouse</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_SendPartyInvitations</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_CreateAttendeeList</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>End_AttendeeListCreated</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
    </bpmn:laneSet>

    <bpmn:startEvent id="Start_BuildingProcess" name="Start building a tree house"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_CollectRequirements" name="Collect requirements"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SendInitialRequirements"
                   name="Send requirements to the architect"
                   messageRef="Message_Requirements"/>
    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Event_ReceiveDraft" name="Receive draft from architect">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MessageEventDefinition_Draft" messageRef="Message_Draft"/>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_RefinementDecision"
                           name="Are further refinements needed?"
                           default="Flow_AcceptPlan"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_RefineDraft" name="Refine draft with additional requirements"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SendAdditionalRequirements"
                   name="Send additional requirements to the architect"
                   messageRef="Message_Requirements"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_CreateMaterialsList" name="Create list of needed materials from the plan"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_OrderMaterials"
                   name="Order categorized materials from several online stores"
                   messageRef="Message_MaterialOrder"/>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_OrderAndFriendsSplit"
                          name="Wait for order processing while contacting friends"/>
    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Event_OrderProcessed" name="Order processing complete">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MessageEventDefinition_OrderProcessed" messageRef="Message_OrderProcessed"/>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_AskFriendsToBuild"
                   name="Ask friends to build the tree house"
                   messageRef="Message_BuildRequest"/>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_OrderAndFriendsJoin" name="Order processed and friends contacted"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_BuildHouse" name="Build the tree house"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SendPartyInvitations"
                   name="Send tree house party invitations to friends"
                   messageRef="Message_PartyInvitation"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_CreateAttendeeList" name="Create list of people attending the party for buying snacks"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_AttendeeListCreated" name="Attendee list created"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Start_Collect" sourceRef="Start_BuildingProcess" targetRef="Task_CollectRequirements"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Collect_SendInitial" sourceRef="Task_CollectRequirements" targetRef="Task_SendInitialRequirements"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_SendInitial_ReceiveDraft" sourceRef="Task_SendInitialRequirements" targetRef="Event_ReceiveDraft"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ReceiveDraft_Decision" sourceRef="Event_ReceiveDraft" targetRef="Gateway_RefinementDecision"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Refine"
                       name="Further refinements needed"
                       sourceRef="Gateway_RefinementDecision"
                       targetRef="Task_RefineDraft">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">furtherRefinementsNeeded</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Refine_SendAdditional" sourceRef="Task_RefineDraft" targetRef="Task_SendAdditionalRequirements"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_SendAdditional_ReceiveDraft" sourceRef="Task_SendAdditionalRequirements" targetRef="Event_ReceiveDraft"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_AcceptPlan" name="Plan ready" sourceRef="Gateway_RefinementDecision" targetRef="Task_CreateMaterialsList"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Materials_Order" sourceRef="Task_CreateMaterialsList" targetRef="Task_OrderMaterials"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Order_Split" sourceRef="Task_OrderMaterials" targetRef="Gateway_OrderAndFriendsSplit"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Split_WaitOrder" sourceRef="Gateway_OrderAndFriendsSplit" targetRef="Event_OrderProcessed"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Split_AskFriends" sourceRef="Gateway_OrderAndFriendsSplit" targetRef="Task_AskFriendsToBuild"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_WaitOrder_Join" sourceRef="Event_OrderProcessed" targetRef="Gateway_OrderAndFriendsJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_AskFriends_Join" sourceRef="Task_AskFriendsToBuild" targetRef="Gateway_OrderAndFriendsJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Join_Build" sourceRef="Gateway_OrderAndFriendsJoin" targetRef="Task_BuildHouse"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Build_Invitations" sourceRef="Task_BuildHouse" targetRef="Task_SendPartyInvitations"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Invitations_AttendeeList" sourceRef="Task_SendPartyInvitations" targetRef="Task_CreateAttendeeList"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_AttendeeList_End" sourceRef="Task_CreateAttendeeList" targetRef="End_AttendeeListCreated"/>
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>
